title: Updating the width word
statement: Let $k,l$ be natural numbers with $k>0$, and let $s,u,v,a$ be Boolean words. Replacing the word at the first width-bank position in the host layout for $(s,u,v)$ by $a$ gives exactly the host layout for $(s,a,v)$.
replaced:
Replacing the word at the first width-bank slot of the host layout for
$(s, u, v)$ by a word $a$ yields exactly the layout for $(s, a, v)$; every
other slot is untouched.
